Netanyahu Rejects Gaza Deal, Demands Hamas Disarmament Before Withdrawal

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected a Gaza proposal attributed to the Trump team, stating Israel will not withdraw from the enclave until Hamas is completely disarmed. Netanyahu conveyed this in a video posted on social media. He insisted that the Israeli army would not pull back from its current positions in Gaza until Hamas's full disarmament. The proposal was reportedly not Israel's draft.
